description: One boss attack pattern. Referenced from data/bosses.json (base attacks + phases[].addsAttacks). All patterns are original designs.

bossId.description: Boss this pattern belongs to (data/bosses.json id).

cooldown.description: Seconds before this attack can fire again.

damageMult.description: Multiplier on the boss's stats.attack for this pattern.

flashColor.description: Telegraph flash tint (decimal RGB) during windup.

hitPauseMs.description: Scripted hit-pause (ms) on strike; clamped by EffectBudgets.

hitStun.description: Seconds of hitstun dealt to the player.

knockback.description: Knockback applied to the player on hit.

range.description: Max horizontal distance (px) at which the AI considers this attack.

recover.description: Seconds of recovery after the strike.

sfxWindup.description: SFX id played when the telegraph starts.

shake.description: Trauma (0-1) added to the screen-shake system on strike.

maxAlive.description: Skip the cast while this many summoned minions live.

radius.description: Horizontal spawn spread around the boss (px).

telegraph.description: Human-readable tell description (design doc; the in-game tell is windup flash + sfx).

windup.description: Telegraph duration (s) before the strike. Damage can never land during windup.

title: BossAttack
